business.purpose: Exercise the native worker through its public protocol, using deterministic response checks and Hegel-generated input boundaries.
rules: Every response identifies JSON-RPC version 2.0.
Every response includes an identifier, including null when the request cannot be identified.

Cases.description: Number of generated cases requested from the planner.

Limit.description: Maximum entries in one transcript page.

business.purpose: Demonstrate a complete run through one independently observed transition.
rules: Fixture responds to requests.

business.description: The fixture is ready to receive a request.
rules: Fixture responds to requests.

business.description: The fixture has completed its request.
rules: Fixture responds to requests.

business.intent: Complete the fixture request.

business.description: The worker identifies itself and is ready for another API request.
rules: The worker reports the expected protocol and core capabilities.

business.description: The worker rejects invalid application data and remains available.
rules: Application validation returns a structured inconclusive fault with an explanation.

business.description: The worker cannot parse malformed JSON.
rules: Malformed JSON receives the parse error code and an unknown identifier.

business.description: The worker rejects an invalid request envelope.
rules: An invalid envelope receives the invalid request code and an unknown identifier.

business.description: The worker rejects scalar JSON-RPC parameters.
rules: Scalar parameters receive the invalid parameters code and preserve the request identifier.

business.description: The worker does not recognize the requested method.
rules: An unknown method receives the method not found code and preserves the request identifier.

business.description: The worker has validated the supplied two-state model.
rules: Validation reports the exact fixture inventory and a stable model hash.

business.description: GraphWalker has planned the fixture route.
rules: The planned route connects the ready state to the done state through the completion edge.

business.description: The worker has produced a complete execution inventory.
rules: The inventory contains the initial check and the transition check without executing either.

business.description: The worker has planned focused Hegel input partitions.
rules: Property planning produces bounded generated partitions with their independent violations.

business.description: A decision provider policy is configured without making a provider call.
rules: Valid call budgets are accepted without an API request.

business.description: The supplied decision answer meets the configured confidence policy.
rules: An internally consistent high-confidence answer returns its selected choice.

business.description: No decision API calls or cache hits have occurred.
rules: Offline policy checks consume no calls, cache hits or provider tokens.

business.description: The decision transcript is empty and has no next page.
rules: An empty transcript reports zero entries and a null continuation offset.

business.description: A fresh worker has no completed execution result.
rules: Results are null until a run completes.

business.description: There is no active run to cancel.
rules: Cancelling an idle worker reports that no active run was cancelled.

business.description: The subject completed both fixture checks and closed its target.
rules: Successful execution verifies the full fixture graph and invokes target cleanup.

business.description: The subject stopped cooperatively after cancellation and closed its target.
rules: Cancellation leaves both selected checks skipped, verifies no edges, and performs cleanup.

business.description: The worker returns its last successful report.
rules: The retrieved report exactly matches the previously completed execution.

business.description: The worker returns its last cancelled report.
rules: The retrieved report exactly matches the previously completed execution.

business.description: The worker acknowledged shutdown and exited successfully.
rules: Graceful shutdown returns an empty result and exits with status zero.

business.description: The subject replayed the selected completion transition independently.
rules: A saved graph case replays from a fresh fixture and executes only its selected test.

business.description: The worker lists the declared numeric input boundaries.
rules: Boundary inspection preserves the nominal example and both invalid sides of the range.

business.description: Hegel generated the selected valid partition and obtained an adapter verdict.
rules: A selected valid Hegel partition invokes the evaluation callback with its exact input and no violations.
